summary_en:
The caller initially asked for 100 normal paper visiting cards with a budget of up to ₹500. They then corrected the request to 200 matte-finish visiting cards with a budget of up to ₹900 and asked the agent to confirm the details. The agent quoted approximately ₹700 for 200 cards, confirmed that this fit the budget, and requested the caller’s name. The caller provided the name Ramesh and email ramesh.audit@example.invalid, and explained that they could not authorize payment. The agent stated that orders below ₹1,000 support cash on delivery, while online payment and credit card payment are not accepted by phone, and that artwork/design approval is required before processing. The caller asked to use cash on delivery, received confirmation that the ₹900 order qualified, and stated that they were placing the order. The call ended with the agent thanking the caller; however, the transcript does not confirm that artwork was approved or that the order was actually processed.

Server check: no confirmed order was recorded for this call, so it was not marked as converted.
next_action: Obtain artwork/design approval and confirm the order before processing; retain cash-on-delivery as the payment method.
